description_expanded:
Beachwood | Watercolor, FL

51 Park Row Lane Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Nestled within the breathtaking Nature Preserves of WaterColor's Gulf District, Beachwood | 51 Park Row Lane is a luxurious vacation rental offering the perfect blend of privacy, comfort, and coastal charm. This spacious home features 4 bedrooms, a bunk nook, and 5.5 bathrooms-all just a 90-second stroll from the WaterColor Beach Club and private beach. Enjoy effortless proximity to the Gulf while indulging in serene privacy and stunning peek-a-boo views of both the Gulf and Western Lake. Beachwood | 51 Park Row Lane provides the ideal foundation for a memorable 30A getaway for you and your loved ones!

The home's first floor greets you with oversized windows and gorgeous rays of sunshine, creating a warm and cozy atmosphere. The first guest bedroom features broad windows with floor-to-ceiling drapes, a king size bed, and an ensuite bathroom with dual vanity sinks, a tub, and a shower. The second guest bedroom is just as elegant, offering a king size bed and an ensuite bathroom with a shower. Lastly, the washer and dryer are located on this floor as well.

The second floor is the heart of the home, where the open-concept floor plan invites you to the living room, dining area, and kitchen. The dining area offers seating for 8 and is surrounded by uniquely structured windows and beautiful decor, leading to the balcony. The balcony provides an additional dining/seating area with a natural gas grill, providing ample space to enjoy a delightful meal while overlooking the serene and captivating Nature Preserves. Flowing seamlessly into the kitchen, you will find stunning marble countertops, stainless steel Bosch appliances, and a large island with seating for 5. The guest bedroom on the second floor has a queen size bed with oversized windows, floor-to-ceiling drapes, and an ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower. There is also a half bathroom located on this floor.

Ascending to the third floor, you will find a twin over twin bunk bed and an additional guest bathroom with a walk-in shower, providing convenient access for your littles! To the left of the stairs is the master bedroom, uniquely designed with luxurious, light colored hardwood floors and vaulted ceilings. The king size bed, ensuite bathroom, and additional lounge area provide the perfect amount of space while maintaining your privacy. Start your day with a morning coffee on the private balcony, or unwind with an evening cocktail with a view you'll surely remember!

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
